name: Direct Finance Scheme by NSFDC (GSCDC)
benefit: - Provide a loan for self-employment to a scheduled caste person at a low interest rate of just 1% to 5%.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000.
